why: who proposes, approves or refuses an agent's new name. Proposing stays with the person, proved, or an agent in its own right by its own key: the agent itself or an agent up its chain of starters. Answering a new name that waits for the person is carried by a raise, by the raised secretary's own key and through the office's one check, so a door the card or the office's list keeps stays kept. The approver kept on the row answers in its own right. The agent itself never answers its own new name, raised or not (wave 13s item 43, measured in tests/a-raised-secretary-answers-a-new-name-for-the-person.test.ts)
